hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Blue Water Logistics as an asset-backed, integrated multimodal logistics and freight-forwarding company headquartered in Hyderabad, licensed as a Multimodal Transport Operator, that is scaling an owned ISO-tank and trailer fleet while expanding across Indian states and international corridors.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Described as providing "end-to-end logistics and supply chain solutions, including freight forwarding, customs clearance, multimodal transportation, NVOCC, ocean, air, surface, and rail freight, along with cargo handling and fumigation services", framed as "One Roof, Six Capabilities".
- "The Company is a licensed Multimodal Transport Operator under the Multimodal Transportation of Goods Act, 1993", granted registration by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways in 2023.
- Network/accreditation moat claimed via JCtrans, Global Logistics Alliance, FIATA Group Bond Programme, Tank Container Development Alliance, Neptune (global NVOCC and LCL cargo network), FFFAI, plus ISO 9001:2015, IATA accreditation, Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) and D&B D-U-N-S registration.
- "Reputed Clientele — Welspun, Yokohama, HSIL, Maxfit & many such companies trust BWL for critical supply chains"; deck cites 1,500+ clients across confectionery, chemicals, textiles, electronics, crockery, natural stones and fitness equipment.
- Deck argues policy formalisation favours it: "Policy Pushing Business Toward Organised Players Like BWL", citing PM GatiShakti, the National Logistics Policy and a shift to organised players from 6% (FY22) to 12-15% (FY27).

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Deck shows deleveraging on its Debt/Equity series: FY23 5.31, FY24 1.82, FY25 1.82, FY26 1.33.
- FY26 returns stated as ROE 49.8% and ROCE 20.4% (from ROE 35.0% / ROCE 14.3% in FY23, peaking at ROE 91.2% / ROCE 36.0% in FY24).
- Growth has been funded rather than distributed: the FY26 cash flow shows Net Cash from Operating Activities of -5,342.6 Rs Lacs against Financing inflows of 10,180.1 Rs Lacs and Investing outflow of -3,348.4 Rs Lacs; equity share capital rose from 800.0 to 1,100.0 Rs Lacs and Reserve & Surplus from 1,222.7 to 7,009.6 Rs Lacs over Mar-25 to Mar-26.
- No dividend policy, buyback or payout intention is stated anywhere in the deck.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Corporate history] Established 2010 as partnership firm "M/s. Blue Water Logistics", converted to a Private Limited company in 2022, transitioned to a Public Company in 2025 and "Got listed on the stock exchange" in 2025.
- [Credit rating] The 2025 milestone states the company "received a IVR BBB/Stable credit rating".
- [Working capital] Trade receivables rose from 4,514.7 to 14,143.4 Rs Lacs between Mar-25 and Mar-26 while FY26 Changes in Working Capital were -9,127.8 Rs Lacs, which sits against the deck's own claim of "negligible bad debts and a strong recovery cycle".
- [Industry sizing, third-party] Global logistics market size cited at $11.23 trillion (2025) to $23.14 trillion (2034) at 8.4% CAGR, and India at $435 billion (2022) to $591 billion (2027) at 14% CAGR, sourced to "SupplyChainBrain, ClickPost, NVOCC Market Growth, Trends Analysis Report by 2033 and others"; deck also states NVOCCs handled ~90% of global container traffic in 2024 (880M TEUs).
- [Investor relations] X-B4 Advisory LLP is named as Investor Relations Partner.
